rationale: handleConfigRequest in src/routes/config.js reads req.query.opts -- an attacker-controlled query-string value -- and passes it to parseOptions() in src/lib/argvParser.js, which calls minimist() directly with no filtering. The vulnerable code path is reachable (empirically verified against this exact installed version, see case-a-reachable-minimist/ground_truth.json and docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md Experiment 1), but only via one hop of indirection through the wrapper module; a search limited to files that literally say 'minimist' next to an HTTP handler would miss it.

authoritative_evidence.detail: handleConfigRequest reads req.query.opts and calls parseOptions(rawOpts).
parseOptions() is a thin wrapper that calls minimist(argvStyleArray) directly.
